definition: Full analysis of an Arabic word into root, pattern, POS, and clitics (the task behind toolkits like MADAMIRA, Farasa, CAMeL Tools).
details: Full analysis of an Arabic word into root, pattern, POS, and clitics (the task behind toolkits like MADAMIRA, Farasa, CAMeL Tools). Still relevant in the LLM era for data preprocessing, diacritization, and linguistically controlled evaluation.

explainer.lead: This task fully analyses an Arabic word into its root, pattern, part of speech, and clitics. It underpins toolkits like MADAMIRA, Farasa, and CAMeL Tools and still matters in the LLM era.

tiers.eli5: Take one Arabic word and break it down to show what it is made of and what job each piece does.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers apply it for data preprocessing, diacritization, and linguistically controlled evaluation. Skipping it can leave Arabic text poorly prepared for downstream tasks.
tiers.paperLevel: Defined as full analysis of an Arabic word into root, pattern, POS, and clitics; outputs are discrete labels, so coverage and ambiguity handling are known limits.

explainer.example: Analysing an Arabic surface word yields its root letters, its morphological pattern, its part of speech, and any attached clitics.
